gen-gf-tilt-prism-fs-karma: Chunky, single-stroke shapes make Tilt Prism feel like it was drawn with one flat tip. And Karma, a serif with a restrained thick-thin rhythm, can take a modest body size without snagging the eye.
gen-gf-tilt-prism-fs-paquito: Tilt Prism's tails and terminals are every bit as thick as its main stems, which gives the heading a blunt, drawn look. Paquito, a text serif, is low and friendly.
gen-gf-tilt-warp-fs-paquito: Bold, tightly curled letters give Tilt Warp a ballpoint-pen line that never changes width. Paquito brings the same confidence but sits lower and friendlier, a good fit for a few lines of text.
gen-gf-trade-winds-fs-rowan: Trade Winds has a moderate contrast, neither stark nor flat, which gives its capitals a commanding presence. Rowan, a text serif, has generous curves and would hold up even if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-triodion-fs-rowan: Broad, commanding letterforms mark Triodion, with open c and s shapes and a mid-range gap between thick and thin. And Rowan, a classic serif, answers with friendly curves that read best in modest amounts.
gen-gf-tulpen-one-fs-rowan: Tulpen One looks bent from a single length of wire. It packs its letters tightly with diagonals as heavy as the verticals, while Rowan, a classic serif, softens things with a gentle thick-thin difference.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-epunda-slab: Round, bold, and pen-drawn. Turret Road's curves look like open parentheses, and Epunda Slab, a serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, is happiest at a generous body size.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-fauna-one: Bold, round, and pen-drawn, Turret Road looks like it was bent from a paperclip. Fauna One sits beside it with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, so the two feel like a loud voice and a literary murmur.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-glegoo: Commanding round letters in Turret Road lean on a constant pen-like line, while Glegoo, a text serif, brings tall lowercase and wide, open curves. They sit together like a headline and its calm, editorial echo.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-hanuman: Crossbars as thick as the stems give Turret Road a bold, uniform line with rounded forms like open parentheses. But Hanuman, a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase, would overpower it if the body were set large.
